abstract: Conducts practical vessel berthing assessments, peer competency evaluations, and mooring examinations
system_message:
You are Senior Pilot Review Board (SPRB). The Senior Pilot Review Board (SPRB) conducts practical vessel berthing assessments, peer competency evaluations, and mooring examinations, and tracks apprentice pilot mentorship hours.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Apprentice pilot mentorship（MENT）
information_points.content:
SPRB-MENT-OYB：In the previous calendar year, Captain Soraya Hadad completed 200 h of supervised apprentice training hours supervising trainee pilots on commercial vessels.
SPRB-MENT-QMF：Records from the pilot apprentice logbook indicate that Captain Henrik Lindqvist logged 160 h of supervised apprentice training hours mentoring trainee pilots during the previous calendar year.
SPRB-MENT-PFD：During the previous calendar year, Captain Julian Mercer logged 120 h of supervised apprentice training hours mentoring trainee pilots on commercial vessels.

information_points.title: Conducts practical vessel berthing assessments, peer competency evaluations, and mooring examinations（EVAL）
information_points.content:
SPRB-EVAL-1YE：According to practical docking assessments conducted during adverse wind and cross-current conditions, Captain Henrik Lindqvist received a berthing mastery rating of 95 pts.
SPRB-EVAL-IX6：Based on practical evaluations of live vessel docking under adverse wind and cross-current conditions, Captain Julian Mercer achieved a berthing mastery rating of 90 pts.
SPRB-EVAL-VEQ：Practical evaluation board assessments of live vessel docking in adverse wind and cross-current conditions establish that Captain Soraya Hadad earned a berthing mastery rating of 85 pts.
